meta.rationale: A big cork board: your apps are notes and polaroids pinned up wherever they fell, a little crooked, like a real wall.
meta.theme-about: corkboard: the whole screen is a cork board (a canvas with cork grain and a wooden frame), each app a paper card pinned with a coloured pushpin, cards of different paper (yellow sticky notes, white index cards, a polaroid with a photo-like gradient) scattered at slightly different angles and positions, red string tying two of them together, handwritten Caveat labels; a torn ticket shows the time. Tactile, messy, homely. (#board, #pins)

desktop.canvas: local PAPER = {"#f7e98e", "#fffdf6", "#bfe3f0", "#f9c6c9", "#c8f0c0", "#fffdf6", "#ffd8a8", "#e6dcff"} local PIN = {"#d63b3b", "#2a6fd6", "#2f9a4a", "#e0a020", "#8a3bd6"} local cards, hot = {}, nil local function rot(cx, cy, x, y, a) local c, s = math.cos(a), math.sin(a) return cx + x * c - y * s, cy + x * s + y * c end function draw(w, h, t) g.rect(0, 0, w, h, "#5a3a20") g.rect(18, 18, w - 36, h - 36, "#b88a58") for i = 0, 900 do local x = (i * 97.13) % (w - 40) + 20 local y = (i * 53.71 + (i * i) % 37) % (h - 40) + 20 g.rect(x, y, 2 + i % 3, 2, i % 2 == 0 and "rgba(90,60,30,0.35)" or "rgba(230,200,150,0.3)") end local apps = g.apps() local px, py, over = g.pointer() cards, hot = {}, nil for i, a in ipairs(apps) do if i > 8 then break end local col, row = (i - 1) % 4, (i - 1) // 4 local cx = w * (0.2 + col * 0.19) + ((i * 37) % 50) - 25 local cy = h * (0.3 + row * 0.38) + ((i * 53) % 60) - 30 local ang = (((i * 29) % 13) - 6) * 0.025 local polaroid = (i % 5 == 2) cards[#cards + 1] = {x = cx, y = cy, a = ang, w = polaroid and 190 or 210, h = polaroid and 220 or 150, paper = polaroid and "#fdfdfb" or PAPER[(i - 1) % #PAPER + 1], polaroid = polaroid, pin = PIN[(i - 1) % #PIN + 1], name = a.name, id = a.id} end for _, c in ipairs(cards) do if over and math.abs(px - c.x) < c.w / 2 and math.abs(py - c.y) < c.h / 2 then hot = c.id end end if cards[2] and cards[6] then g.line(cards[2].x, cards[2].y - cards[2].h / 2 + 12, cards[6].x, cards[6].y - cards[6].h / 2 + 12, "#c42a2a", 2) end for _, c in ipairs(cards) do local lift = c.id == hot and 6 or 0 local hw, hh = c.w / 2, c.h / 2 local sx1, sy1 = rot(c.x + 8, c.y + 10, -hw, -hh, c.a) local sx2, sy2 = rot(c.x + 8, c.y + 10, hw, -hh, c.a) local sx3, sy3 = rot(c.x + 8, c.y + 10, hw, hh, c.a) local sx4, sy4 = rot(c.x + 8, c.y + 10, -hw, hh, c.a) g.poly({sx1, sy1, sx2, sy2, sx3, sy3, sx4, sy4}, "rgba(40,20,5,0.35)") local x1, y1 = rot(c.x, c.y - lift, -hw, -hh, c.a) local x2, y2 = rot(c.x, c.y - lift, hw, -hh, c.a) local x3, y3 = rot(c.x, c.y - lift, hw, hh, c.a) local x4, y4 = rot(c.x, c.y - lift, -hw, hh, c.a) g.poly({x1, y1, x2, y2, x3, y3, x4, y4}, c.paper) if c.polaroid then local a1, b1 = rot(c.x, c.y - lift, -hw + 14, -hh + 14, c.a) local a2, b2 = rot(c.x, c.y - lift, hw - 14, -hh + 14, c.a) local a3, b3 = rot(c.x, c.y - lift, hw - 14, hh - 50, c.a) local a4, b4 = rot(c.x, c.y - lift, -hw + 14, hh - 50, c.a) g.poly({a1, b1, a2, b2, a3, b3, a4, b4}, "#3f6f9a") g.circle((a1 + a3) / 2 + 20, (b1 + b3) / 2 - 20, 16, "#f6d06a") else for k = 1, 3 do local l1, m1 = rot(c.x, c.y - lift, -hw + 18, -hh + 50 + k * 26, c.a) local l2, m2 = rot(c.x, c.y - lift, hw - 18, -hh + 50 + k * 26, c.a) g.line(l1, m1, l2, m2, "rgba(60,90,160,0.25)", 1) end end local tx, ty = rot(c.x, c.y - lift, -hw + 18, c.polaroid and (hh - 44) or (-hh + 32), c.a) g.text(tx, ty, c.name, "#2a2218", c.id == hot and 34 or 30, "Caveat") local pxn, pyn = rot(c.x, c.y - lift, 0, -hh + 10, c.a) g.circle(pxn + 2, pyn + 3, 9, "rgba(0,0,0,0.35)") g.circle(pxn, pyn, 9, c.pin) g.circle(pxn - 3, pyn - 3, 3, "rgba(255,255,255,0.6)") end end function click(x, y) for i = #cards, 1, -1 do local c = cards[i] if math.abs(x - c.x) < c.w / 2 and math.abs(y - c.y) < c.h / 2 then return "open:" .. c.id end end end
